summary: Scotts Miracle-Gro filed an 8-K reporting that on September 11, 2026 it redeemed all $250.0 million principal of its 5.250% Senior Notes due 2026 at par plus accrued interest, terminating that material indenture and extinguishing noteholder rights except payment. The company simultaneously announced completion of capital allocation initiatives, achievement of its $275 million free cash flow target and reaffirmed fiscal 2026 guidance. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or change-of-control element appears. The debt retirement removes a fixed charge and mirrors a US issuer tender/redemption; watch for follow-on refinancing, leverage trajectory and any incremental buyback or dividend commentary.
